contract.mutation: Atomic $set of intended documentation fields; no whole-document replacement and no heartbeat retry loop. Concurrent lease takeover remains stored unchanged.
contract.normalization: Store plain and proposal documentInput exclude the three collaboration fields from document hashes and returned documents; HTTP accept/restore additionally serialize through existing documentation DTO plus version.
contract.legacyWrites: Same exact content predicate tolerates lease-only changes; request/import patches reserve all three lease fields. Real content races retain existing conflict/retry semantics.
contract.historyAndOutbound: Existing description-only snapshots and outbound DTO allowlists retained; lease identifiers never become documentation content.
